solution: He tried to burgle the shop by throwing the brick at its window. The window was bullet-resistant and did not break. The brick rebounded into his head and knocked him unconscious. His injury resulted from his own attempted break-in, explaining the arrest.
canonical_facts: He was attempting to burgle the shop using a brick to break the window.
The bullet-resistant window stayed intact and the brick rebounded.
His own rebounding brick struck his head and caused unconsciousness.
The arrest was for the attempted break-in, not because he was injured.
